content.tex: \(n\) vertical lines are drawn inside a rectangle. The total number of rectangles is \(an^{2} + bn + c\) .
Find the values of a, \(b\) and \(c\) .

parts.text: Two horizontal lines are drawn inside rectangle PQRS to form a total of 6 rectangles. For each of these 6 rectangles, 3 rectangles are formed when one vertical line is also drawn inside rectangle PQRS . P Q S R P Q S R So the total number of rectangles is 18.

content.tex: Two horizontal lines are drawn inside rectangle PQRS to form a total of 6 rectangles.
For each of these 6 rectangles, 3 rectangles are formed when one vertical line is also drawn inside rectangle PQRS.
\(P\quad Q\quad P\quad Q\)
\(S\quad R\quad S\quad R\)
So the total number of rectangles is 18.
